release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.52 unifies Retailer Accounts and Sessions into one viewport-bound Accounts workspace. The separate user-facing Sessions page is removed from the normal workflow and legacy Sessions navigation now resolves into Accounts. Accounts uses the same side-mounted retailer hierarchy pattern as Tasks and Profiles: Pokémon Center, Target, Walmart, and Amazon each expose independently named account/session groups, with existing unassigned accounts preserved through an Ungrouped Accounts lane. The workspace uses a 300px retailer rail, viewport-aware internal pagination instead of page scrolling, a compact account list, and a selected-account inspector that combines account identity, linked task/profile/proxy context, local session age/readiness, troubleshooting, and recent state transitions. Existing account features remain available through the unified workspace, including add/edit, duplicate, enable/disable, delete, tags, notes, import/export, group assignment, and bulk profile/proxy assignment. Existing Sessions functionality is preserved without a second page, including Login Session, Close Session, Test, Refresh, manual session state, Bulk Preflight, Pre-Drop Snapshot, health notifications, attention queue, preflight history, and launch snapshots. Group create, rename, and delete use Tachyon-owned modals rather than native browser dialogs. Dedicated Go and real Chromium regression coverage verifies retailer/group isolation, account creation, session actions, legacy Sessions-route consolidation, viewport pagination, zero Accounts page/list scrolling, the complete browser suite, and the 120-task soak.
